body: I love the smell of deleted code

I did a manual skim of the diff and marked a few things. I also got an agent to compare this to all my feature branches, and marked several functions that would be restored verbatim with those branches, so i'd be inclined to keep those. i filtered this list a bit, omitting stuff that could be structurally better; i'll just let the diff agents regenerate hopefully-better versions of those.

I definitely spotted a few core things that I was surprised arent used, though not disbelieving. this could probably use some functional review sanity checking.

all in all a lot of stuff i'm glad is on the way out though
